data.issue: every Ghidra fingerprint carried size 0 after the qualified-name change (a comment swallowed the size assignment); the knowledge base skipped all of them (min size 32) and no name could be lent to a stripped build
data.reproduction: run DECOMPILE on any job; 01_evidence/decompiler/fingerprints.json → all size 0; knowledge stats: ghidra occurrences do not grow
data.fix: size restored; the stage and `knowledge refresh` fill a missing size from the callgraph row (same evidence)
data.test: engine/tests/test_decompile.py, test_knowledge.py; DECOMPILE stage version 5 re-run on both fixture jobs

data.issue: the frozen v2 bundle's 00_manifest/input_manifest.json was installed over AB's ingest manifest, losing usage_context / source_availability (and before D-026 the ownership declaration) after STATIC
data.reproduction: ingest → STATIC → read 00_manifest/input_manifest.json: keys generated/inputs/mode/tool only
data.root_cause: v2 layout and AB layout share the file name; install copied blindly
data.fix: the v2 file is installed as static_input_manifest.json

data.issue: exports carried build-machine paths (workspace, temp, repo, JUCE dir) in six JSON files; the scanner flagged one (only /home and C:\Users patterns)
data.reproduction: export the fixture job; grep /tmp and the repo path in validation/*.json
data.root_cause: no scrubbing of this machine's roots; scanner blind to temp roots and JSON-escaped Windows paths
data.fix: scrub_machine_paths replaces project / workspace / state / tools / env tool roots / home / temp with placeholders (evidence/01_evidence/{paths,strings,binary} exempt: original developer's paths are evidence); scanner patterns extended

data.issue: the whole-project loop regenerated the handoff after the validation checkpoint, leaving the project git tree dirty (A6 gate: status clean)
data.root_cause: handoff written after the last stage checkpoint
data.fix: loop commits `validation: agent handoff regenerated` after writing the handoff
data.test: engine/tests/test_checkpoint_rules.py; fixture-level sequence on the next full run

data.issue: a function first recorded from a stripped build kept its decompiler label (FUN_…) as name_hint even after a symbol build named it; names could never be lent
data.reproduction: analyse stripped then symbol build; SELECT name_hint FROM function → FUN_…
data.root_cause: COALESCE(name_hint, new) kept the first value
data.fix: a real name always replaces a decompiler label; `ab-cli knowledge refresh <job>` re-records stored evidence
data.test: measured: refresh recorded 16 455 Ghidra fingerprints with qualified names

data.issue: Ghidra's symbol-keyed RTTI recovery found none of the plugin's classes on a stripped ELF (33 classes, all std/cxxabi)
data.reproduction: DECOMPILE on the stripped fixture before commit 433e130
data.fix: structural Itanium pass (raw typeinfo-name scan → typeinfo object → bases → vtables, null-slot tolerant)
data.test: measured: 709 classes / 592 vtables on the stripped fixture; engine/tests/test_vtable_layout.py

data.issue: BinaryData getNamedResource pairs could not be resolved on a stripped image (pointer symbols PTR_DAT_/PTR_PNG_/PTR_s_<… not matched; pairs unnamed)
data.reproduction: DECOMPILE on the stripped fixture before commit 8b3…
data.root_cause: regex assumed identifier-like symbols and DAT_/PTR_ + hex
data.fix: symbol-table resolution, deref for PTR_, name from the branch's JUCE name-hash case constant; pseudo-C of every candidate kept as evidence

data.issue: the DSP top-5 gate on stripped builds depends on names the knowledge base lends; a stripped build analysed before any symbol build shows only structural roles
data.reproduction: phase 3 gate 'waveshaper and filter in top-5' on a fresh workspace
data.root_cause: by design: names come from symbols or fingerprint knowledge
data.fix: documented; the gate prints the basis; knowledge refresh + rerun after a symbol build
